issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 request to preserve profile URL references from extension worksheet Reference types such as Reference(Resource){profileUrl} in generated extension definitions, specifically for Other.AdverseEvent.cause.item in the QICore AdverseEvent profile.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 5094. The migrated git application is 68b14f5700d4e510e21e777c41355e1eda34135b (#5955 - fix missing profile references), which changed ProfileGenerator to emit an explicit TypeRef profile instead of always emitting the base resource StructureDefinition URL. The related parser-enablement issue FHIR-5938 was applied earlier in 81d1bff591ce339694764d726741b17b6770fe00.
additional_context: The affected source was historical QICore content. It started as source/other/adverseevent-qicore-profile-spreadsheet.xml, was renamed to source/basic/basic-adverseevent-qicore-profile-spreadsheet.xml when Other became Basic, and was later moved out of core source under guides/cqf. Current source/fhir.ini lists Basic and AdverseEvent as active resources but has no active QICore AdverseEvent profile package, and current core plus the FHIR Extension Pack contain no extension-adverseevent-qicore-cause-item or matching QICore AdverseEvent source.
reconciliation: Created an empty audit commit and made no source edits because the historical fix was applied and the affected artifact is outside the current core build.
